node.statement: Exact scalarization of the comparison term. Put d=J_{P,Q,n}(Z)^dagger X in C^n. Entrywise, the registered column-hilbert-inner-product-displays and the defining formula for J give [(Z^dagger dot X)]_i=sum_k Z_{ki}^dagger dot X_k=d_i u_Q. Under the canonical identification by q_0 from node 1.1 this vector is alpha d, whereas J_{P,Q,n}(Z)^dagger X is d. Hence q_Q((Z^dagger dot X)-J_{P,Q,n}(Z)^dagger X)=|alpha-1| ||d||_2. Node 1.1 and lem-hcb4-canonical-gram therefore give this at most A e ||J_{P,Q,n}(Z)|| q_P(X)<=A e(1+C_J e)||Z|| q_P(X).
